Venue Layout
Flutter package on pub.dev GitHub & docs

Flutter seat picker & seating plan editor

Build the room. Pick the seat. Try venue_seat_picker, a seating-plan editor, viewer and interactive seat picker for Flutter and the web.

Arrange tables and chairs, shape curved rows, or start with a ready-made venue. Use the same portable plan in your editor and customer booking interface.

Open interactive demo Try the JavaScript seat picker

No sign-in required. The demo uses sample data and does not create reservations or payments. The editor demo currently opens in Czech.

What you can try

  • Design a seating plan: place tables, chairs, curved rows, standing areas and custom furniture.
  • Edit an entire venue: drag and drop, copy objects, select groups, change styles and undo changes.
  • Explore templates: halls, theatres, conferences, lounges, buses and train carriages.
  • Preview seat selection: zoom into the plan and try the customer picker in Flutter or JavaScript.
  • Bring your own application: portable JSON layouts, themes and host-supplied availability and prices.

The package supplies the plan and selection interface. Your application manages reservation locks, live availability, orders and payments.

Try the demo

  1. Open the editor and choose a venue template.
  2. Move a table, adjust its chairs or add a row of seats.
  3. Switch to preview to explore the seating plan as a guest.

For integration examples and the API reference, visit venue_seat_picker on pub.dev or read the project documentation.

flutter pub add venue_seat_picker

For a JavaScript website, see @festapp/venue-layout on npm.

Built for Festapp. Open source under the MIT license.
